**Overview**  
Everbright Teguh Hotel Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited boutique hotel operating in Kuantan, Selangor. The company was incorporated on 29 July 1989 and has a paid‑up share capital of 500,000 RM, with Director 4 as the dominant shareholder (90.66 %). It is governed by five directors; the most recent appointment was Director 2 within the past six months. Financial statements are available for 2022 and 2024, showing revenues of 6,227,194 RM and 6,520,818 RM respectively, both audited with an unqualified opinion.
